title: Star-Survey Portfolio
pitch: A software engineer's portfolio you can fly: steer a luna moth under the real night sky, tie its stars with silk for fireworks, and read the work in quiet AR readouts over it.

topics.title: Pitch
topics.summary: A software engineer's portfolio you can fly: steer a luna moth under the real night sky, tie its stars with silk for fireworks, and read the work in quiet AR readouts over it.

topics.title: Audience
topics.summary: Recruiters and hiring managers first (from a résumé/LinkedIn link, 1–2 min, desktop or phone); engineers and players second.

topics.title: Pillars
topics.summary: 1 The sky is the scene · 2 Work in two moves · 3 Fireworks are the one motif. Never gate the résumé behind play.

topics.title: Voice
topics.summary: Calm, precise, warm: instrument readouts with a friendly guide. Never "Unleash your potential in an epic cosmic journey!"

topics.title: Story
topics.summary: Two rangers resurvey a sector from far away; you see their feed. If it gives off its own light it's the real sky; everything else is AR overlay, projected from the orb (rings, shimmer, a pulse). The moth is the engineer, just remapping trails; Cori (C.O-R.I, Cosmic Operations – Research and Information) is the guide and the fun: silk, red thread, fireworks are hers. The game is dessert.

topics.title: References
topics.summary: Proposed: sci-fi AR HUD (user image), Bruno Simon's portfolio, Outer Wilds, Sky: Children of the Light.

topics.title: Color
topics.summary: One palette for site and game: Cosmic Carnival + plum neutrals + signal teal for information. Gold and flame only for actions, selection and wins; headings are text. Stars and sky shaders exempt.

topics.title: Type
topics.summary: Rajdhani for titles and buttons (instrument labels), Inter for reading, JetBrains Mono for data, HUD and game canvas text. Seven sizes (10–48px, none below 10), three letter-spacings.

topics.title: Spacing & Grid
topics.summary: Reset removed so padding works. 8 steps on a 4px grid (2–48px). Breakpoints = Alchemy tiers: tablet 600, desktop 1024. Page edge 16/24/48; panel column 540px.

topics.title: Shape & Depth
topics.summary: Sharp frames with 12px corner ticks; 2px chips; full dots. Glow means alive: none at rest, hover/active glow in the role color. 1px lines, 2px focus ring, one 4px frost, 5 z layers. The UI shows at 90% (text), lines and ticks ≈ 80%.

topics.title: Motion
topics.summary: Crisp UI, slow sky: fast 150 / base 200 / enter 300 / slow 500 / scene 1000ms; standard, enter, exit easings. Reduced motion = calm: loops stop, moves fade, game play untouched.

topics.title: Projection
topics.summary: The orb projects the overlay: fine scanline rings spread out from it on surfaces only; edges shimmer with slow procedural noise that grows with distance from it; a pulse from the orb is the update (draws things in, re-seeds the noise) on appear, section change, Cori landing and every ~12 s. Text stays clean; calm holds still.

topics.title: Containers
topics.summary: AR overlay: Frame (see-through, 1px signal line, corner ticks), Menu list (replaces flip cards; selected = gold), Leader lines from things to their menus, Plate for HUD and Cori.

topics.title: Controls
topics.summary: One Button: action (outlined gold + ticks) / quiet (signal line); sm 24 · md 32 · lg 40; no rest glow, focus ring signal, press = glow + contained firework. Rail labels mono 10, current gold.

topics.title: Effects
topics.summary: Fireworks are the motif: 5 palette sets + 2 rare cool (teal, violet), ~8 designs, 4 patterns. Every press = a mini 8-petal paper ring, contained. Calm: fireworks appear open, warp off, glitter/embers ¼. Characters keep their colors; Crystal + sparkles gone.

topics.title: Content Blocks
topics.summary: One Entry {eyebrow, title, meta, body, tags, links} for jobs, projects, OSC, school: Menu row short, Detail full. Five text parts (eyebrow, title, meta, body, chip), left-aligned; 0–3 links as quiet sm buttons ↗. Skills = Readouts; Cori = a line on a Plate.

topics.title: Avatars
topics.summary: Moth and butterfly keep their art; the feed projects them from the orb like all the overlay: rings across the wings, a rim that shimmers with distance and lights with the pulse, wing edges dropping out now and then; plus tracking ring, ghost when fast, callsign tag.

topics.title: Orb & Cori
topics.summary: Orb: transmitter (load) → docked with the moth in his tank (site) → field down (game) → recall (beam in, pulse). Cori: tours once, lands on what matters (résumé, rail, entry, LAUNCH, the tank), idles at random (loop, rest on a corner, visit the moth), speaks on landing or ?. The rail stays as the plain nav.

topics.title: Shell & Navigation
topics.summary: Rail + comms plate (GitHub, résumé, contact) on top, content column, info readout bottom-left, orb bottom-right. Sections are hash addresses (/#work); wheel/swipe steps one. Game hands off: HUD Plates take the same corners. One SECTIONS table; dev controls dev-only.

topics.title: Opening
topics.summary: The orb loads the moth from a cocoon, space flickers on, it docks bottom-right with the moth in its tank. Cori welcomes, tours the site (a little random, like in the game), ends on the mission at Play: resurvey the sector. LAUNCH drops the field; pause brings him back. Work never behind the game.

topics.title: Pages & Sections
topics.summary: as-is: one route (/) with six sections switched in place by scroll: about, work, skills, projects, osc, play. /sandbox is dev-only.

topics.title: Layouts
topics.summary: Readout (About, Skills: one 540 Frame), Menu + Detail (Work, Projects, Open Source: intro 540, then menu 280 + detail 460 = 760 from 1280 wide; below that the row opens in place), Launch (Play: shell only). Content stays between rail and bottom corners and scrolls inside its Frame.

topics.title: Responsive
topics.summary: The orb is the controller everywhere: stick (steer / dial sections); tap the stick = button 1 (silk / next, LAUNCH); button 2 at the ring top (recall / previous); side button left of the ring = Cori (guide / help). 136/168/200px, fully on screen. Phone: rail dots + current label, LINKS button, rows open in place.

topics.title: Accessibility
topics.summary: WCAG AA floor. Reading frames void/60, text-faint #A18FAA (≥4.5 at the UI's 90% opacity everywhere text sits). Full keyboard, landmarks + tablists, one live region, 44px touch, calm motion, document.title per section.

topics.title: Stack & Constraints
topics.summary: as-is: Next.js 16 static export on GitHub Pages, Tailwind v4 (CSS-first), framer-motion, React Three Fiber sky. The WebGL sky is the backdrop, not page UI.

topics.title: Scope
topics.summary: Everything decided ships, site and game, in 10 Apply steps: foundations → components → layouts + shell → accessibility → orb stick → the overlay (projection, avatars) → Opening + Cori → fireworks + calm → content → docs.
